title: ScheduleSpec
description: 1.213.0: the closed schedule of an automation asked for in a sentence — what the deterministic parser (`chat_api/automation/schedule.py`) read from the ask, what the person sees and may change on the card (*When Every day at 07:00 · Europe/Kyiv*), and what the template's trigger is built from (`cron` by one function, never from the model's words — rule 85). `cadence` is the closed set; `time` is the local wall-clock time in the person's zone; `weekday` names the day of a `weekly` schedule, `day_of_month` the day of a `monthly` one; `cron` holds a five-field expression only when `cadence = cron` (the Studio's own schedules read back as themselves). The model's extraction, when any, is the same object flagged as a proposal (`intent-analysis.schedule_proposal`).

timezone.description: IANA zone — the person's (the organization's default when hers is unknown).

weekday.description: `weekly` only — 0 = Monday … 6 = Sunday (ISO order, the card's words come from the key `automation.weekday.<n>`).

day_of_month.description: `monthly` only — 1…28 so every month has the day.

cron.description: `cron` cadence only — a five-field expression the parser could not say in words (a Studio schedule read back); for every other cadence the cron is computed, never stored here.
